findings.title: ThermalState constructor defaults are published as temperatures through five ungated paths
findings.claim: With no thermometer behind a field, the climate entity, Mixed Hot Water, Thermal Battery Charge and the Indoor/Outdoor sensors publish the ThermalState() constructor default (55/40/22/21/5 degC) or a number derived from it as an available state or attribute, while the sensor platform's _MeasuredTemperatureMixin makes the corresponding temperature sensors unavailable.
findings.mechanism: _MeasuredTemperatureMixin gates only DHWTemperature/Buffer/Slab/LowerFloor/FloorReturn/UpperFloor sensors on reading_ok. The same ThermalState fields leave ungated through climate.extra_state_attributes (dhw_temperature, slab_temperature, lower_floor_temperature, upper_floor_temperature, current_temperature), coordinator._dhw_mixed_water (litres from the 55.0 default -> Mixed Hot Water state), coordinator._battery_view (components.dhw_tank/buffer_tank/slab/lower_floor and the SOC state), IndoorTempSensor (21.0) and OutdoorTempSensor (5.0 while the plan is solved on the forecast; Estimated COP follows the 5.0: 3.32 vs 2.62/2.19 at the real -3/-8 degC).

evidence.unit: publications (RESULT default_temperature_leaks) over 85 cells x 2 cycles; plus RESULT outdoor_default_published=10; Mixed Hot Water available without a tank reading in 38 cells (300.0 L, 37.5 shower minutes)
evidence.machine: MacBookAir10,1 Apple M1 8 GB, numpy/OpenBLAS, thread-pinned
evidence.contention_note: fan-out; ten other auditors on the box (load1 2.2-6.0); counts are contention-immune; two full runs identical

findings.title: numpy scalars reach entity attributes (three sites) and the Predicted Savings state, bypassing _plain_types
findings.claim: _build_data_dict copies OptimizationResult scalars and the solar-gain trajectory into the payload without _plain_types, so np.float64 values reach extra_state_attributes of Optimization Schedule (schedule[i].solar_gain, every cell), Savings Percentage (deferred_energy_cost) and the climate entity (predicted_savings), and the Predicted Savings state, in valve-storage topologies.
findings.mechanism: optimizer.py:1534 builds solar_gain_trajectory from ndarray elements (compute_solar_gain returns a Python 0.0 only for sr <= 0); optimizer.py:5697 rounds one of them into current_action.solar_gain_kw (daylight); result.predicted_savings/deferred_energy_cost are numpy on the buffer-store path and round() keeps the type. _plain_types is applied to predictive_info only.

evidence.unit: distinct attribute sites (RESULT numpy_attribute_sites); RESULT unserialisable_attributes=3630 per value; RESULT numpy_state=30 (predicted_savings in the 15 valve_storage/two_tank/coil cells x 2); schedule.solar_gain in 85/85 cells
evidence.machine: MacBookAir10,1 Apple M1 8 GB, numpy/OpenBLAS, thread-pinned
evidence.contention_note: fan-out; counts are contention-immune; two full runs identical

findings.metric_definition: Distinct (entity, attribute root, leaf) sites where an np.generic/np.ndarray is found in extra_state_attributes over all snapshots; plus the count of snapshots whose state is a numpy scalar.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py:_build_data_dict (two _plain_types wraps) or optimizer.py lines 1534 and 5697; no golden drift expected (golden.py:r rounds through float; confirm with GOLDEN_MODE=drift). Severity is low because Home Assistant's json_encoder_default converts float subclasses; an np.int64 on the same path would not be converted - the judge should confirm the installed core's hook.

findings.title: Alphabetical order splits the hot-water family (hot_water_*/mixed_hot_water vs dhw_*) and four other families
findings.claim: Sorting the 55 sensors by entity id or English name breaks the DHW family into three runs (dhw_* | hot_water_cost, hot_water_energy | mixed_hot_water); tariff, learning, card-headline, lifetime and two-zone families are split too; Swedish names split the DHW family the same way and the lifetime accumulators three ways.

evidence.unit: family splits in entity-id order (RESULT family_splits_entity_id); name_en 15; name_sv 16; per family (id): dhw 2, tariff 2, learning 2, accuracy 1, card_headline 3, lifetime 2, two_zone 3, ecl110/pv/thermal_battery 0
evidence.machine: MacBookAir10,1 Apple M1 8 GB, numpy/OpenBLAS, thread-pinned

perturbation.change: Rename hot_water_energy/hot_water_cost/mixed_hot_water translation keys into the dhw_* family with matching translations (a naming release: the suggested object id follows the key).

findings.metric_definition: Sum over ten hand-listed families (matrix.py:FAMILIES) of (contiguous runs the family forms in the sorted entity-id / name order) minus one.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: sensor.py translation keys, strings.json, translations/en.json, translations/sv.json, README entity tables; the card's id-suffix contract (headline stats) is unaffected.

non_findings.claim: Every MEASUREMENT/TOTAL/TOTAL_INCREASING state is numeric and finite; both TIMESTAMP sensors publish tz-aware datetimes; no ENUM sensors exist
Device class x state class pairs and units are consistent (DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES); MONETARY units equal coordinator.currency
No NaN/inf, set or non-str key reaches any attribute on any platform, including the unscrubbed binary_sensor/climate/switch paths
No entity caches state: entities built on cycle 1 read exactly what fresh entities read from the cycle-2 payload
41 direct numeric readers follow their payload key within rounding after the inputs change
No entity raises from available, native_value/is_on or extra_state_attributes in any cell
Every non-climate entity pre-assigns <platform>.heat_pump_optimizer_<translation_key>; unique ids are unique; every entity has an icon
strings.json, en.json and sv.json carry identical entity key sets equal to the entity roster; every Swedish name differs from the English
The disabled-by-default set is exactly the six niche sensors the README lists, and nothing the quick start or the card needs is disabled
Feature gating works as documented: DHW, two-zone, measured-power, tariff, PV, frequency and contract entities are unavailable without their feature and available with it
